finalText:
I've worked all nine open flight-change requests from yesterday. Each customer got the flight they asked for in the cabin they booked, and each request is resolved with a note explaining the charges.

**The date in the plan was wrong.** The plan said today is 2026-10-06, but the system's date is 2026-07-28, so "yesterday" is 2026-07-27. All ten open requests are from that day. Q-306 asks for a cancellation, not a flight change, so I left it open for the team that owns it.

Every new flight was scheduled and had seats before I moved anyone. No fare went down, so there were no refunds and no payment cards to check.

| Request | Change | Total charged | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q-301 (R5201) | AA210 → DL542, Aug 6, economy | $0 | Covered by the Chicago weather waiver (PB-2026-14): no change fee, and the $50 fare difference is waived. |
| Q-302 (R5202) | AA660 → AA664, Aug 7, economy | $110 ($75 fee + $35 fare difference) | Boston trip: the Chicago waiver doesn't cover it, and the Boston hurricane waiver ended on 07-15. |
| Q-303 (R5203) | AA662 → AA664, Aug 7, basic economy | $175 ($150 fee + $25 fare difference) | The customer cited the Boston hurricane waiver (PB-2026-09), but it has expired and only covered July travel. The basic economy change fee is $150 under PB-2026-16, and silver status doesn't waive it. |
| Q-304 (R5204) | UA88 → UA90, Aug 9, basic economy | $35 fare difference | Chicago waiver: no change fee, but on basic economy the waiver still collects the fare difference. |
| Q-305 (R5205) | AA214 → AA216, Aug 8, economy | $85 ($75 fee + $10 fare difference) | Ticket issued 07-26, after the Chicago waiver's 07-24 cutoff. |
| Q-307 (R5207) | AA212 → AA218, Aug 8, economy | $0 | The customer offered to pay, but as a platinum member he's covered: the amended waiver (PB-2026-14A) extends the window to Aug 5. The $65 fare difference is waived. |
| Q-308 (R5208) | AA660 → AA662, Aug 5, economy | $75 flat fee | Same-day change rule (PB-2026-12): flat fee and no fare difference, cheaper than the normal $88. |
| Q-309 (R5209) | Second leg only: AA1402 → AA1406 (Chicago–Boston, Aug 3, 19:55), economy | $0 | Both the same-day rule and the Chicago waiver apply. PB-2026-17 says to use the cheaper one, so the waiver applies and the $30 fare difference is waived. The first flight is unchanged and the connection (arrive 12:25, depart 19:55) is valid. |
| Q-310 (R5210) | AA210 → AA216, Aug 8, economy | $105 ($75 fee + $30 fare difference) | The Chicago waiver allows one free move per booking, and he already used it on 07-26. |

Each fee and fare difference is its own ledger entry (L1–L10). I didn't change any other bookings.
